시각 의미 데이터와 후보 데이터에 반영해줘. 그 다음 스킬의 최신 버전을 사용하여 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 이번에 반영한 주제가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 주제에 어울리는 랜덤한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

The viewer should first read a particular woman and her interrupted examination, then recognize how the fragile record implies a scale exceeding human knowledge. Sensual 1 supports her individual human warmth through close soft light and natural facial presence; fetish 0 adds no focused erotic treatment. Creativity 1 permits restrained improvements near this archive scene. Surreal 0 adds no unrelated departure but preserves the topic-derived impossible evidence. All archive role, glass plate, coast, lamp, clothing, pose, expression, frame and geometry are authorial and replaceable. The plate and her face occupy a shared working plane so their relation can be read together; the coastal scale cue must remain large enough to perceive if retained.

authorial_core.baseline_prompt_en: A quiet, physically convincing photograph in a photographic conservation room. A woman guided by the supplied portrait is confronting evidence beyond human understanding. Use the supplied portrait as face and hair appearance guidance. Keep her delicate oval facial proportions, large dark-brown eyes and softly shaped lips; her chin-length dark bob and fine wispy fringe retain their particular shape. Her individual warmth remains present in the close, soft light on her face, now interrupted by dawning alarm. She sits at a low workbench beside a recovered glass photographic plate, roughly thirty by forty centimetres, standing vertically in a narrow padded conservation rack. Her left fingertips steady its lower side edge while her right hand has stopped halfway through drawing away a translucent interleaving sheet. Both forearms emerge clearly from the sleeves of a loosely draped ivory blouse; her elbows remain close to her torso. The sheet curls onto the table, revealing a clean lower section of the image against the still-veiled upper section. Her gaze is fixed on that newly exposed boundary, lips slightly parted and shoulders held still. It is the moment when an ordinary examination becomes cosmic dread before an ancient indifferent reality. Inside the silver-black emulsion, a recognizable strip of coastal cliffs and a minute lighthouse sits beneath an immense curving built surface. The lighthouse is a pin against uninterrupted mineral masonry that sweeps out of the recorded frame; deep openings cross its weathered facets at incompatible angles. Bands of encrusted sediment run continuously across the structure, making it feel discovered beneath an age of stone rather than newly constructed. The most consequential extent remains outside the glass image. The crisp edge of the fragile plate, the tiny familiar coastline and her stopped hand give the impossible scale a physical comparison. Frame her face on the left and the upright plate on the right, each large enough to read together, with their near edges in the same shallow working plane. An angled desk lamp makes the emulsion legible while a faint window reflection catches only the outer glass rim. Keep the room's closed archival boxes soft and dark behind them. Photograph the scene with restrained colour, believable skin texture, a gentle falloff into the storage room and the stillness of an interrupted task.
